theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lur_graph_chart_adjoint_identities
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (u : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (δ₁ : ℝ), DifferentiableOn ℝ u (ball 0 δ₁) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ₁, ∀ w : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (ι w) (u v) = 0) → ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ 1 ∧ (∀ z : Euclid (n + 1), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (ι z) = z) ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ₁, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (x + ι v + u v - x) = v ∧ x + ι v + u v - x - ι (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (x + ι v + u v - x)) = u v ∧ ∀ y : Euclid (n + 1), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (fun y => x + ι y + u y) v y) = y
